title: Phase 0: Project & GitHub setup
description: Demo criterion: repo, CI, project board, templates live; `pnpm dev` boots web+api+db. See docs/roadmap.md

title: Phase 1: Auth & users
description: Demo criterion: register, login (email + Google), profile page, roles.

title: Phase 2: Listings
description: Demo criterion: host creates a stay/car/tour with photos; visible on detail page.

title: Phase 3: Search & discovery
description: Demo criterion: map + filter search across all three types; listing pages public.

title: Phase 4: Booking & payments
description: Demo criterion: search → book → pay (test mode) → confirmation email, end to end.

title: Phase 5: Reviews, messaging, wishlists
description: Demo criterion: two-sided reviews, guest↔host chat, saved listings.

title: Phase 6: Admin & operations
description: Demo criterion: moderation panel, host payouts, Sentry + metrics, rate limiting.

title: Phase 7: Polish & launch
description: Demo criterion: i18n (EN/RU/KG), SEO, a11y pass, performance budget, production deploy.

title: Phase 8: Advanced (stretch)
description: Mobile app, search engine migration, payments service extraction. Ongoing.
